captured_cases.expected_outcome: The real B Team version 6 run, whose seats cleared the map, gets a located agreement defect on the map unit naming the five rows that contradict the cards' spans, clear cells on the four other read units, and not-applicable cells elsewhere.
The real Vivacom version 6 run records clear on every read unit and not-applicable elsewhere.
The real version 5 B Team page, rendered from its state, carries no span fields, stage list, deploy month or widening month: every lens cell is not applicable with reason no-check.
The same page opened with explicit payload flags records every lens cell as not applicable with reason no-profile, and consistency refuses with that reason.

atomic_step.outcome: The critique machinery gains a code-owned payload-consistency lens: for a deliverable opened with a declared profile, `consistency` reads the bound payload against the page and fills both seats of that lens on every unit a check reads — a located revise where the page contradicts the payload, clear where it does not, not-applicable with a reason where no check reads the unit or no profile is declared; it never raises an owner question and read-run never sends it to a reader.
atomic_step.practical_value: On 2026-09-05 both blind seats cleared the B Team version 6 activation map while five of its cells contradicted the cards' spans (the craft series ran Months 6 to 12 and read Sustain). A unit-by-unit reader cannot see a page contradict itself across units; code reading the bound payload can.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: The real B Team version 6 run records the map cell as an agreement defect naming its five contradicted rows and located prints them; the real Vivacom version 6 run records clear on every read unit; the version 5 page and an explicit-mode run record the lens as not applicable with their reasons; legacy seven-lens runs still load.
